units.CD4402-lisala: Lisala territory (Mongala province) lies far from the eastern conflict zones and there are no known armed groups holding territory in it. Lisala town, the provincial capital, and the Binga plantation town are policed by the Congolese National Police (PNC), with a small FARDC detachment and the usual provincial state services present. Rural villages of the Lisala, Binga and Boso Manzi areas along the Congo river and the inland roads have no known armed-group activity and are assessed as default state (PNC) presence, with customary chiefs settling local disputes. NOTE: no web research could be done for this unit (search budget exhausted, news sites blocked by the egress proxy), so this assessment rests on general background knowledge, not on 2025-2026 sources, and should be re-checked.
